name: Travel Planner by Gildhart
changelog: • A jump to the planner lands below a sticky header that sits under a banner. "Check What Vaccines You Need" and a link with ?going=<country> put the planner's top, or its card, under such a header: on arrival the header is below the banner, so the planner did not count it. A sticky header is now measured where it sticks (its own top), not where it is when the page opens. Found on Chislehurst Pharmacy Group's page, 19 November 2026.
